  ✓ brief   ✓ questions   ● draft

  test-writer — adds table-driven tests for a package and runs them

❯ Purpose
    Add table-driven tests for one package at a time. Done when every exported
    function has a case in its table and the package's tests pass.

  Scope
    The package you were pointed at and its _test.go files. Leave the exported
    API and every other package alone.

  Restrictions
    Never change an expected value to make a case pass.

  Method
    Read the package, then its tests, then write the cases the table is
    missing. Run the package's tests after each file.

  Report ⚠ empty · the drafter left it; a report is required

  Tools
    read + write + execute · it can change things, in its own copy of the tree

  Commands
    none stated · the session's own command lists apply

[↑↓] move
[enter] take it
[enter] refine it with a note
[R] refine the whole draft with one note
[e] edit it yourself
[x] clear it
[tab] the sections or the card
[shift+↑] scroll the profile up
[shift+↓] scroll the profile
[esc] back a step

glyphs
⚙  a read: a file, a search, a listing
$  a shell command
✎  an edit, a write, a patch or a memory
◇  a sub-agent
⇄  a call to a server not marked read-only
✻  the model writing its calls, counted as they arrive
⛁  a published report page
≡  a reading of the session
✓  a compaction that brought the window back
·  accepted, not started
▸  running
✦  the classifier is deciding
✗  failed
⊘  refused: dim by you, red by a rule
[?] hide the keys

    ␛[38;5;244mfunction has a case in its table and the package's tests pass.␛[m

  ␛[38;5;254mScope␛[m
    ␛[38;5;244mThe package you were pointed at and its _test.go files. Leave the exported␛[m
    ␛[38;5;244mAPI and every other package alone.␛[m

    ␛[38;5;244mNever change an expected value to make a case pass. Never delete a test.␛[m
